_comment: The router limits, read by scripts/skill-budgets.py and by tests/pack-index-budgets.test.ts. A router is at most router_max tokens, or router_max_by_pack[pack id] where the pack is named. A pack in index_router_only may have an index over the harness budget (extensions/skills.ts SKILL_BUDGET.pack, 1,000), and is then shown by its router line alone; every other pack keeps its index within that budget.
